question: 设二元函数 $f(x, y) = \begin{cases} xy \frac{x^2 - y^2}{x^2 + y^2}, & x^2 + y^2 \neq 0 \\ 0, & x^2 + y^2 = 0 \end{cases}$ ，求 $f_{xy}(0, 0)$ 与 $f_{yx}(0, 0)$ .
answer: $$ \begin{array}{r l} f _ {x y} (0, 0) & = \lim _ {y \to 0} \frac {f _ {x} (0 , y) - f _ {x} (0 , 0)}{y} = \lim _ {y \to 0} \frac {- y}{y} = - 1, \\ f _ {y x} (0, 0) & = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {f _ {y} (x , 0) - f _ {y} (0 , 0)}{x} = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {x}{x} = 1. \end{array} $$

steps.text:
分析 由于(0,0)是函数的分段点，所以其一阶与二阶偏导数只能用定义计算.

由偏导数的定义，得

$$
f _ {x} (0, 0) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x , 0) - f (0 , 0)}{x - 0} = 0, \quad f _ {y} (0, 0) = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (0 , y) - f (0 , 0)}{y - 0} = 0.
$$

当 $x \neq 0$ 时，有

$$
f _ {y} (x, 0) = \frac {\partial}{\partial y} \left(x y \frac {x ^ {2} - y ^ {2}}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}\right) \Bigg | _ {y = 0} = \frac {x \left(x ^ {4} - 4 x ^ {2} y ^ {2} - y ^ {4}\right)}{\left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \Bigg | _ {y = 0} = x.
$$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{r l} f _ {x y} (0, 0) & = \lim _ {y \to 0} \frac {f _ {x} (0 , y) - f _ {x} (0 , 0)}{y} = \lim _ {y \to 0} \frac {- y}{y} = - 1, \\ f _ {y x} (0, 0) & = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {f _ {y} (x , 0) - f _ {y} (0 , 0)}{x} = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {x}{x} = 1. \end{array}
$$
